title: Self-Management Dashboard Coverage Gap
dataSources: Pump telemetry (`health:glucose`), lab results (`health:lab`), therapy sessions (`health:pt`), symptom diaries (`health:symptom`), care tasks (`health:ops`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management telemetry — insulin-pump events, A1c lab imports, physical-therapy rep logs, and symptom diaries — streamed to Splunk HEC via device exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=health:ops signal_name=* currently_tracked=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(currently_tracked="yes",1,0))) as matched by signal_name
| eval currently_tracked_coverage_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - currently_tracked_coverage_pct
description: Measures the percentage of self-management signals that end with currently tracked coverage by signal.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which signal are helping or hurting self-management signals.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `currently tracked coverage` on `health:ops` events and summarize the hit rate by `signal_name`.
visualization: Table of signal with percentage of self-management signals ending with currently tracked coverage.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how often currently tracked coverage happens for each signal so you can see where self-management signals go smoothly or get stuck.
